assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: A cube in oblique view with three rotation axes: a blue face axis through the centres of the top and bottom faces, a red vertex axis through two opposite vertices, and a green edge axis through the midpoints of two opposite edges.

difficulty_rationale: Needs the rotation group of the cube (its 24 elements in four types) and their cycle structures on the vertices, combined through Burnside's lemma; casework by hand is longer.
